title: MyWelcomer
description: A plugin that allows players /welcome newly joined players to promote friendliness and activity in chat.
body:
Note:
If you run into any issues, bugs or want to give your geniune suggestion join my discord server.
- https://discord.gg/EfVPXXjFCY
  
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What's New?
- nothing this plugin was just made yesterday, althought expect new features coming soon.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Features:
- [✔] Simple placeholders to make configuring the plugin easier.
- [✔] editable prefix!
- [✔] Custom normal welcome msgs and tiered welcome msgs.
- [✔] tiered/milestone rewards!
- [✔] a .yml file to track welcomed players!
- [✔] custom rewards when welcoming a player duh!
- [✔] over 50 sounds that you can choose from to play when someone welcomes a player!![MyWelcomer is a lightweight plugin that encourages community interaction by letting players use /welcome to greet newcomers. With customizable messages, milestone rewards, economy plugin support, and tracking, it’s the perfect addition to any friendly server.](https://i.postimg.cc/XYKHV1Y6/Chat-GPT-Image-Apr-14-2025-10-09-03-PM.png)
